notes.title: Christmas Update 2 - Christmas hat edition
notes.notes:
A second update to the Christmas theme, now with Christmas hats for the good guys (yay!) and winter outfits and balaclavas for the bad guys (boo!).

Ho ho ho!

notes.title: Update Notes for 29 Nov - Chrisrtmas Update
notes.notes:
Christmas Mode is now officially live!

Plus, the following fixes:

- Fixed Factory Platform level jumps so that Floyd can make them
- Tweaked Festive Menu, so it doesn't appear each time you return to the menu

notes.title: Christmas 2022 Update
notes.notes:
Machine Gun Fury

Christmas 2022 Update

Let’s get into the festive zone and shoot lots of stuff to the soothing sounds of Christmas!

This free update transforms MGF into a winter wonderland. Just update the game and select ‘Christmas Mode’ to get into the festive spirit:


 New wintery Christmas-themed visuals
 Updated ice-encrusted level tilesets
 New music soundtrack, with ten different SID festive music tracks
 New destructible scenery, including Christmas trees, snowmen & presents


We hope you enjoy the update, and from all of us at Reset Games, have a wonderful Christmas!

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 29
notes.notes: - Automatically pause game when Steam Overlay is opened

notes.title: Update notes for November 12
notes.notes:
Several fixes in this build:

- Score tally on the end of level fixed
- Homing missile now tracks boss turrets
- Fixed wall cannons and made them destructible again
- Removed the ability to stand on top of enemies in the platform levels

Tweaks:

- Boxes now block enemy fire
- Further difficulty tweaks across later levels
- More signposting/help tips

notes.title: Final Update for November 10
notes.notes: - The first platform level has been tweaked to make it a little easier.

notes.title: Update Notes for November 10
notes.notes:
Fixes:

- Enabled player movement on boss explosion so you can avoid any remaining enemies/projectiles and make kills
- Fixed score not tallying on Game Over
- Fixed sorting on the enemy dead bodies

Tweaks:

- Made the beginning of Level 1 slightly easier
- Added Help Text for Level 1 first grenade pickups
- Set default fire buttons to Z and X

notes.title: Mac Build Update
notes.notes:
Mac build is now fully working.

Also remapped the default fire controls to Z and X, so LeftControl is no longer used.
